title: Feature to filter clipboard history by type (text, images, other files, etc)
line: The clipboard popup and widget have a new filter button next to the search field to show only text, images or files.
explanation: The clipboard history could only be narrowed down with the search field (which matches text) or the Starred tab, so there was no way to list only the images or the files you copied; they were mixed in with everything else. The history proxy model gains a type filter that works together with the starred filter, and the popup header gets a "Show Only…" filter button next to the search field with All Types, Text, Images and Files. The button looks pressed while a filter is on, the empty state says "No matches", and the filter goes back to All Types when the history becomes empty.

commits.message:
klipper: Add a filter to show only text, images or files in the history

The clipboard history could only be narrowed down by text or starred
state, so finding an image or a copied file meant scrolling through all
of it. Add a filter button next to the search field to show one type.
